title: Pushforward of H^n restricted to a Lipschitz image under a measurable left inverse is at most Λ^n·(H^n⌞S)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and E := ℝ^P (Euclid P) with its Borel σ-algebra. Let H^n := μHE[n], the normalized n-dimensional Hausdorff measure on E. Let Λ ≥ 0, let φ : E → E be Λ-Lipschitz, and let ψ : E → E be Borel measurable with ψ(φ(x)) = x for every x ∈ E. Then for every set S ⊆ E, not assumed measurable, the image under ψ of H^n⌞φ(S) is at most Λ^n times H^n⌞S: ψ_#(H^n⌞φ(S)) ≤ Λ^n·(H^n⌞S) as measures on E. Equivalently, H^n(ψ^{-1}(A) ∩ φ(S)) ≤ Λ^n·H^n(A ∩ S) for every Borel set A ⊆ E.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (φ ψ : Euclid P → Euclid P) (Λ : NNReal) (S : Set (Euclid P)), LipschitzWith Λ φ → Measurable ψ → LeftInverse ψ φ → (μHE[n].restrict (φ '' S)).map ψ ≤ ((Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n) • μHE[n].restrict S
